# r1 - Run the migration across the live roadmaps

Run the shipped `roadmap-graph` command over every live roadmap in the project stores: dry run
first, then write. Twenty-three files, of which one already carries an exact `## Graph` and must
come back untouched, one carries a `## Graph`-like heading and must be refused, and seven use the
legacy `## Waves` grouping. The twenty-eight files under `roadmaps/archived/` are out of scope
(D16), and there is no global `~/.plastic/roadmaps` directory. Record the before-and-after
frontier for each roadmap so a changed dispatch order is visible rather than discovered later by
the auto loop. This node runs only after v1 passes, because it writes the owner's stores.

## Deposit
`resources/migration--live-roadmaps-<date>.md` in this intent directory, carrying every row below.

| Row | What the deposit records | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| r1.1 | The dry-run output for all twenty-three live roadmaps, with the derived edges listed per file | A write nobody previewed is a write into the owner's data on trust alone |
| r1.2 | The file skipped for an exact `## Graph` and the file refused for a `## Graph`-like heading, named | Proves D6 and D13 held against the two live files that could have lost owner-authored content |
| r1.3 | For the seven `## Waves` roadmaps, the heading each one carries after the run | Proves D12 held: no roadmap gained a second grouping heading that would orphan the human's |
| r1.4 | `roadmap-next` state, roadmap, frontier batch, and dispatchable ids before and after, per roadmap | A migration that silently changes what the auto loop dispatches next would be discovered by an executor, not by a reader |
| r1.5 | Every difference between the before and after frontier, explained, including whether the plan review's `chat-shell-maturity.md` rank flip is gone | An unexplained difference is a migration bug hiding as a computation |
| r1.6 | A byte-level check that the kill-gate paragraphs inside `graph-ready-plastic.md` survived | That record is the ratification of 327 D43 and exists nowhere else |
| r1.7 | The `index-projection` drift report per store, compare mode, no write | Records the drift that existed on the day INDEX became a projection, without touching the spine |
